processing_parameters.production_upscale: forbidden; native logical pixels are placed 1:1

prompt_lines: Asset type: source artwork for a native 32x32 pixel-art inventory icon
Input images: Image 1 is the red healing-potion edit target; Image 2 is the exact approved 22x30 occupancy and round-bellied volume reference.

Primary request: Keep Image 1's red liquid, cyan-white glass, cork, fine one-pixel detail, and compact round-flask identity. Change ONLY its native authored dimensions and silhouette occupancy so it matches Image 2's 22 logical pixels wide by 30 rows tall volume.

Hard pixel-grid contract: retain Image 1's approximately 26-source-pixel square grid cells. Physical subject bbox must be approximately 570px wide by 780px tall, equivalent to 22x30 native logical pixels. Do not make the grid cells smaller and do not zoom the whole canvas.

Exact body proportions: top and short neck about 9 rows; shoulders expand over 4 rows; broad 22px-wide round bottle belly remains near full width for 10-13 rows; bottom closes in only 4 rows. Keep a flattened rounded base. This must look fuller and more jar-like than Image 1, not pear-shaped.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat uniform #ff00ff chroma-key with large empty margins.
Invariants: one centered object; vivid red/crimson liquid; pale cyan-white glass; brown cork; continuous one-logical-pixel near-black contour; native 1x1 highlights and diagonal steps.
Constraints: hard opaque pixel art, no antialiasing, blur, smooth gradients, text, medical cross, label, shadow, floor, extra objects, watermark, or #ff00ff inside the subject.
Avoid: 20x24 undersized result, long tapered pear body, thick double outline, enlarged 16x16 look, repeated 2x2 macroblocks, any subject under 28 or over 30 logical rows.

rejected.reason: rejected: measured approximately 20x24 and is visibly smaller than the approved 22x30 reference volume
